description: Use this when you have an id from `search` and need that data center facility record (search/fetch format). Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata} — a citable public summary of one data-center facility (name, operator, location, status, market). For full structured specs (capacity MW, coordinates) use get_facility or open the url.

id.description: A facility id/slug from a prior `search` result, e.g. equinix-dc1-ashburn
